item.title: Scoutadelic Songbook vol 1 PDF Download
item.description: THIS IS A PDF DOWNLOAD Wanting to start your very own campfire sing-along, or even wanting something for your Scouts to know the words. The Scoutadelic Songbook contains almost 30 campfire songs from rounds, actions to normal sing-along, in sustainable materials. Each song also has a QR code to scan to see how the song is sung and what actions are needed when.

item.title: Global Scouting Badge – Portugal
item.description: To gain this badge, you can either visit Portugal (such examples being Moot 2025) whilst in Scouting and have at least explored their culture and tried something new whilst there. item.title: Spy Hunt 3 Event Badge
item.description: To gain this badge you must have completed Spy Hunt 3 event online in 2025. This badge is only available for those people who logged in on our surprise event during the JOTA/JOTI weekend of 17th October - 19th October 2025. http://play.scoutadelic.com Please be aware this is not a uniform badge

item.description: Our 120th episode show badge. Limited edition. The badge depicts Oggy in Kenya, to celebrate our visit to Nyeri Kenya for our 120th episode The badge will be delivered in December 2025 to celebrate our 120th episode Please be aware this is not a uniform badge
